name: get_api_details
description:
Get full API details for a specific class or member by exact name.

Available engines: unity, unreal_ue4, unreal_ue5

Returns the complete API documentation for a section matching the name — method signatures, parameters, return types.
Use this AFTER search_api_reference to drill into a specific class or member you already identified.
Do NOT use this for conceptual questions — use search_docs instead.

Example: get_api_details('OVRInput', engine='unity')
Example: get_api_details('AMRUKRoom', engine='unreal_ue5')

engine.description: Which API index to search. Options: unity, unreal_ue4, unreal_ue5

name.description: The section name to look up (e.g., 'HandGrabInteractable', 'AMRUKRoom')
